purpose: test whether a public arrival-triggered release plan restores future service after uncertainty-aware contingency staging

arms.direct: phase-specific plan using announced sector before arrival
arms.robust: phase-specific plan using announced/opposite public hypotheses before arrival and common release plan after arrival
arms.masked: phase-specific plan with pre-arrival sector identity removed

primary_endpoint: urgent_opposite future service completion and weighted service value, jointly constrained by primary completion and energy
decision_rule: Expand only if robust exceeds direct and masked on the urgent-opposite primary endpoint in at least two of three seeds, while preserving the post-arrival future-service action fraction and primary reliability.
interpretation_boundary: Development-only. The release event and all pre-arrival planning inputs are public; hidden future position and urgency are unavailable before arrival.
